content:
Physiological testing

INSCYD METABOLIC TESTING

Lab-quality metabolic testing from your own power data. €189, or included in Premium.

Buy the test · €189What you get ↓
INSCYD Power-Performance Decoder

A FULL 360° PHYSIOLOGICAL ASSESSMENT

INSCYD’s Power-Performance Decoder (PPD) enable us at Cigala Cycling to create a full 360° physiological assessment of each athlete – the same as you already know from lactate testing in the lab or in the field – BUT without the need to test in the lab or even be physically present with each athlete. The test can be carried out indoor or outdoor with even a Zwift protocol for you to use. This is a game-changer.

We offer the cutting edge metabolic testing to ensure your training is optimised to your physiology meaning maximal training adaptations

INSCYD will benefit your training schedule and performance with both a scientific foundation and precise predictability.

With INSCYD you’ll get full picture of your physical capacities and also a prediction of your training and racing outcomes. ​

The performance you are looking for is composed of a variety of components and metrics, but if you only focus on FTP, heart rate zones, or keep training only according to your Rate of Perceived Exertion, you’ll miss accuracy and efficiency.

What INSCYD measures

THE METRICS THAT MATTER

INSCYD takes into account, and connect to one another, the most important metrics for training purposes:

  • VO2max

  • Anaerobic threshold

  • Lactate accumulation and recovery

  • Fat and carbohydrates combustion

  • Recovery

  • VLamax (or glycolytic capacity)

For example, with INSCYD you can finally understand the interactions between your aerobic system and your fuelling needs. Do you wonder, “How much should I consume per hour in order to maintain my performance?” With INSCYD, you’ll know.

Each of the above metrics measured by INSCYD is critical to performance and remember, each sport performance is predictable and can be broken down to these fundamental elements.

Take VLamax, for example. Although you might have never heard of it, VLamax. It is the single most important measurement to enhance your performance. VLamax is the maximum production of lactic acid in your blood and gives you a complete understanding of your anaerobic metabolism (which yes, is crucial in endurance events, too!). VO2max is aerobic, now we know the anaerobic piece, which turns out to be at least as important.

What the report shows

INSCYD VS CONVENTIONAL TESTING

How it works

WHAT WE ORGANISE

  1. 1

    ALL YOU NEED IS A POWER METER

    Test on your own bike with your own power meter or smart trainer: no special equipment.

  2. 2

    NO LAB NEEDED

    No masks and no blood samples, and you don’t need to travel to a lab or be with us in person.

  3. 3

    SIMPLE PROTOCOL

    A short set of all-out efforts, indoors or outdoors. There is even a Zwift protocol for you to use.

  4. 4

    FULL PROFILE

    VO2max, anaerobic threshold, VLamax, fat and carbohydrate combustion, lactate accumulation and recovery.

  5. 5

    FULL METABOLIC PROFILE

    How your aerobic and anaerobic systems work together, and how much you need to eat per hour to keep your performance.

  6. 6

    RESULTS REPORT

    Your INSCYD report, with the training zones and the focus your training needs next.

USED BY THE WORLD’S BEST ATHLETES · WorldTour teams include Bora Hansgrohe, Lotto Jumbo Visma, Team CCC and Team Alpecin Fenix.
